// Two kinds of check. "objects" queries return one series per offending object, so the
// digest can name it; "value" queries return one number compared against a threshold.
const checks = [
  { name: 'Pods that never scheduled', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'pod'],
    query: 'kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1' },
  { name: 'Pods pending or failed', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'pod'], detailLabel: 'phase',
    query: 'kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1' },
  { name: 'Containers stuck waiting', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'pod', 'container'], detailLabel: 'reason',
    query: 'kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason == 1' },
  { name: 'Containers restarting', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'pod', 'container'], detailSuffix: ' restarts in 24h',
    query: 'sum by (namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h])) > 0' },
  { name: 'Failed Jobs', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'job_name'], detailSuffix: ' failed',
    query: 'kube_job_status_failed > 0' },
  { name: 'Deployments missing replicas', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'deployment'], detailSuffix: ' unavailable',
    query: 'kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable > 0' },
  { name: 'StatefulSets missing replicas', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'statefulset'], detailSuffix: ' not ready',
    query: '(kube_statefulset_status_replicas - kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready) > 0' },
  { name: 'DaemonSets missing pods', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'daemonset'], detailSuffix: ' unavailable',
    query: 'kube_daemonset_status_number_unavailable > 0' },
  { name: 'PVCs not bound', kind: 'objects', labels: ['namespace', 'persistentvolumeclaim'], detailLabel: 'phase',
    query: 'kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{phase!="Bound"} == 1' },
  { name: 'Nodes not Ready', kind: 'objects', labels: ['node'],
    query: 'kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"} == 0' },
  { name: 'Nodes under pressure', kind: 'objects', labels: ['node'], detailLabel: 'condition',
    query: 'kube_node_status_condition{condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure",status="true"} == 1' },
  { name: 'Memory requested of allocatable', kind: 'value', unit: '%', warnAbove: 90,
    query: 'round(100 * sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"}) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"}))' },
  { name: 'Root disk used', kind: 'value', unit: '%', warnAbove: 85,
    query: 'round(100 * max(container_fs_usage_bytes{id="/",device!~"/dev/loop.*"} / container_fs_limit_bytes{id="/",device!~"/dev/loop.*"}))' },
  { name: 'Soonest certificate expiry', kind: 'value', unit: ' days', warnBelow: 14,
    query: 'round(min(certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds - time()) / 86400)' },
  { name: 'Players online', kind: 'value',
    query: 'round(sum(game_server_players) or vector(0))' },
];

return checks.map((check) => ({ json: check }));
